title: Cooler pastel tones and trustworthiness in cyber-banking interfaces
statement:
In a cyber-banking interface study, cooler tones and a moderate pastel main color with lower brightness produced stronger reported trustworthiness than a bright primary-color alternative, supporting restrained cool palettes for trust-oriented banking UI. (ScienceDirect)

Options:
- Trust-oriented cool: cool tone + moderate pastel + low brightness (fits: secure, calm, reliable)
- Balanced cool: cool tone + moderate pastel + medium brightness (fits: modern, approachable, professional)
- Warm restrained: warm tone + moderate pastel + low brightness (fits: human, friendly, distinctive)
- Bright primary: bright primary colors (fits: energetic, youthful, attention-seeking)
appliesWhen: Applies to: fintech. Audience: adults, general.

source.title: Designing towards emotional usability in customer interfaces—trustworthiness of cyber-banking system interfaces
